construction.source: the exact finitely presented group function and subgroup generators in GAP perf6.grp

marking_universe.lifts: all v*S and w*T with v,w in the full 128-element kernel, filtered by orders 2 and 3
marking_universe.gauge: all simultaneous conjugations by the full kernel
marking_universe.order: candidate family key, then lexicographic permutation pair
marking_universe.generation_gate: compute subgroup order for every kernel-conjugacy orbit representative

positive_control.each_candidate: degree 112, group order 64512, kernel order 128, kernel element orders 1:1 and 2:127

downstream_stop_rule.preflight: finish all three candidates and all marked-pair gauge orbits
downstream_stop_rule.formal_measurement: if generating orbits exist, freeze every such orbit before the first shadow; stop immediately at the first reduced-image loss or zero-survival element
